cards.text: Every contributor gets instant read hits from build.smithers.sh. Untrusted outputs stay isolated and never poison the cache.

cards.text: Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity to smithers.sh/smithersai/smithers-ci/mcp to draft TODOs, issues, PRs, and stacked changesets.

cards.text: Every community PR renders a 6-category Lighthouse backpressure preview. A controlled sandbox or maintainer certifies the final gate.

cards.title: People merge and credit stays yours
cards.text: Your PR merges under your name with full credit. Agents never approve or merge.
